name: Shenzhen Matrix Dynamic Technology Development Co., Ltd.
name_zh: 深圳市矩阵动力科技开发有限公司
summary:
Shenzhen Matrix Dynamic Technology Development is associated with AI.FRAME, a miniature humanoid robotics platform for programmable movement and experimentation. The robot uses multiple servo-controlled joints to perform actions such as walking, dancing and interactive games.

The AI.FRAME project was introduced as an open-source platform with customizable commands, upgrade options and assembled or self-assembly configurations. Its small form and configurable behavior make it relevant to hands-on robotics learning and development. The emphasis is on understanding and modifying a complete humanoid system, from its mechanical structure to the sequences of movements it performs.
